reason: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli, and I would be paying that every month for a magnesium capsule. The sachet in my bag is a nice idea since I forget stuff at home, but not nice enough to pay extra for.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I can't tell why a capsule in a foil packet is worth $7 to $10 more.
would_change_my_mind: A small trial pack (7 days) for around $9 to $12, or the 30-day box at about $19.99 or less.
